TASKS_DESC: Each ledger is updated on its own cadence; tasks past their next update date turn overdue and are escalated to group planning.
VERSION_NEW_DESC: Recalculate knitting capacity from current orders, production progress, machine counts and the previous version's ERP backlog. Packing and special-process tables are carried over.
PUBLISH_DESC: Publish {{label}} as the group summary. Published versions are read-only.
NO_VERSION_DESC: Click New version to calculate the first capacity ledger.
FORMULA: Formula: off-machine date = ship date − lead time (7–10 d); producible days = off-machine date − as-of date (planning window {{window}} d); knitting capacity = producible days × daily output × machines; unproduced = OTD orders not yet knitted + ERP backlog; free capacity = knitting capacity − unproduced; free rate = free ÷ capacity. Only the machine count is entered manually.
ROW_EDIT_DESC: {{base}} · {{needle}}: the row is recalculated after saving.
BACKLOG_DESC: {{base}} · {{needle}}: {{otd}} pairs not yet knitted in OTD, plus the backlog synced from ERP.
MACHINES_DESC: Machine count is the only manually maintained figure; changes apply to the next generated version. Daily output is synced from ERP.
TASK_COMPLETE_DESC: Complete this update of {{name}}; the next due date follows the frequency.
